Deliverables are grouped under Lot 1, Lot 2, and Lot 3 across warehouses including Callao Central Warehouse (Av. Argentina 2850), Arequipa Regional Warehouse (Parque Industrial Mz. F), and Trujillo Regional Warehouse (Av. Nicolás de Piérola 1210). Rows represent specific items: 1.1 Single phase meter 2 wires, 5(60) A, class 1; 1.2 Single phase meter 3 wires, 5(80) A, class 1; 1.3 Meter box in polycarbonate with sealing screws; 1.4 Single phase meter 2 wires, 5(60) A, class 1; 1.5 Meter box in polycarbonate with sealing screws; 2.1 Three phase meter 4 wires, 5(100) A, class 1, with RS-485 port; 2.2 Three phase meter 3 wires, 5(100) A, class 1; 2.3 Current transformer 200/5 A, class 0.5S; 2.4 Test terminal block for indirect metering; 2.5 Three phase meter 4 wires, 5(100) A, class 1, with RS-485 port; 2.6 Current transformer 200/5 A, class 0.5S; 3.1 Data concentrator with PLC and 4G modem; 3.2 Head-end software licence, per 1,000 meters; 3.3 Installation and commissioning kit for concentrator; and 3.4 Training of client staff, 5 days.
